reviews.text:
Service not as described. There are so many things wrong with this app. For me it is very useless. There are also incorrect nutritional values. 

The app review page advertises use of calories and g (for macros) but the app uses kcal (not the same as calories) and oz. When adding your own custom food there’s no way to use decimal points for oz. 

Some recipes have incorrect nutritional values. 262 calories (or kcal) for 1 1/2 lbs of broccoli and 6 garlic cloves. This “meal” is listed as only 1 serving to which you can’t log less than 1 serving in your food diary.

The AI recipe generator spits out recipes that require you to buy more of what you already have. I had 1 medium sweet potato and the recipe wanted me to get two large sweet potatoes. Sure I can do some calculating of my own by isn’t this app supposed to cut down on that exact inconvenience?

The grocery list tool only makes a list for a few preselected meals it gives you. You can’t swap out for your AI generated meals, custom meals, or other meals within the app having some sanity when it comes to listed nutritional content. I can’t even add my own custom food because the fields are in kcal and oz. 10g of protein requires a decimal point in ounces. 

The 30-day money back guarantee is a scam. The fine print says they only process a refund if you don’t see results. Who is seeing results in 30-days? 90 days seems more reasonable. You can’t process a refund because you don’t like the app but this is way far beyond “not liking” the app. It’s unusable for me.

All of these issues would be tolerable if I had the option to get my money back. More people would be inclined to give your app a try and give USEFUL feedback rather than critically berate it if you weren’t a predatory developer.
